svg.title: Two ways to put bits on tape
svg.desc: The bits zero, one, zero, one shown as frequency-shift keying with two tones, and as Commodore short-medium or medium-short pulse pairs. Schematic waveforms with normalised bit durations.
svg.text: Two ways to put bits on tape
The same four bits; a different rule for reading the signal.
Commodore also uses a long pulse for markers; this comparison shows data bits only.
Schematic, not the recovered audio. Bit widths normalised for comparison; no speed comparison implied.
